summary: Ares Core Infrastructure Fund filed an 8-K under Items 3.02 and 8.01 to report a monthly closing of common share sales totaling $1,114.2 million across four share classes (I, D, N, S), priced at the June 30, 2026 NAV per class. No underwriting discounts or commissions were paid; Class I shares carry no upfront load, while D, N, and S classes impose loads capped at 2.0%–3.5% of NAV if sold through certain agents. The offering is exempt under Rule 506(b)/Regulation S. This is a routine periodic capital raise by a non-listed fund, not a special situation event. No watch items or arbitrage angle apply.
